name: farmers-to-consumer
description: WomenBiz - digital entrepreneurship platform for rural women. Frontend (seller + customer app), backend API (includes the admin API), shared domain types.

scripts.build: npm --workspace @f2c/backend run build && npm --workspace @f2c/frontend run build && npm --workspace @f2c/admin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @f2c/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace @f2c/frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace @f2c/admin run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @f2c/backend run test && npm --workspace @f2c/frontend run test && npm --workspace @f2c/admin run test
